# City Property Services

> Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar real estate consultancy founded and led by Mukesh Vasani, with 27+ years in the market and 8,000+ transactions. A CIRIL member (owner-operated commercial real estate network across 30+ Indian cities). Advises buyers, sellers, tenants, landlords and investors on residential, office, retail, industrial, warehousing, land and investment property. RERA registered: AG/GJ/AHMEDABAD/AHMADABADCITY/AUDA/AA00003/220329R2.

Office: 703 & 704 Zion Prime, Near Copper Stone, Thaltej Shilaj Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380052, India.
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98249 00778. Email: coordinator@cityprop.co.in.
Coverage: Ahmedabad (west, east, north, south), Gandhinagar and GIFT City, plus the Sanand, Changodar, Aslali and Bavla industrial belts.

Every page on the site is static HTML; property pages carry price, area, locality, photos and a description. Listing URLs follow https://cityprop.co.in/property/<slug>/ and locality guides https://cityprop.co.in/localities/<slug>/. All URLs end with a trailing slash.

## Services

- [Corporate offices](https://cityprop.co.in/services/corporate/): Offices and corporate spaces to lease or buy, from compact startup floors to full buildings.
- [Retail](https://cityprop.co.in/services/retail/): High-visibility shops, showrooms and food-and-beverage spaces where customers can find you.
- [Industrial & warehouse](https://cityprop.co.in/services/industrial-warehouse/): Warehouses, sheds, cold storage and industrial land across Ahmedabad's logistics belts.
- [Investment](https://cityprop.co.in/services/investment/): Preleased assets and prelaunch opportunities chosen for steady income and long-term growth.
- [Residential](https://cityprop.co.in/services/residential/): Homes to buy, sell, rent or lease, matched to your locality, budget and lifestyle.
- [Land](https://cityprop.co.in/services/land/): Plots and land parcels for homes, business, industry and investment, with the checks done right.

## Property listings

- [Buy](https://cityprop.co.in/buy/): All properties for sale in Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar — flats, bungalows, offices, showrooms, plots and investment assets, filterable by locality, type, bedrooms and budget.
- [Rent & lease](https://cityprop.co.in/rent/): Homes for rent plus office, retail and warehouse leases across Ahmedabad.
- [Map](https://cityprop.co.in/map/): Every listing on an interactive map of Ahmedabad with region, locality, type and budget filters.
- [Localities](https://cityprop.co.in/localities/): Area-by-area guides to 100+ Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar micro-markets with connectivity, what each is known for, and live listings.
